faqNote: Review snapshot: August–September 2026. Material for hypotheses, not a promise of demand or revenue.
faq1A: {topics} editorial breakdowns and {ideas} app ideas based on public reviews. Inside, you'll find user situations, observations, and quotes to help you find a problem worth building for.
faq2Q: What can I try for free?
faq2A: The full “{topic}” breakdown, {freeIdeas} ideas from it, the catalog, and search. You can save material, add notes, and export the free ideas.
faq3A: Reviews help reveal a need, but they don't prove people will pay for a new solution. inApp gives you a basis for hypotheses. The next step is to talk to potential users and test your idea.
faq4Q: How do the website and app differ?
faq4A: Free material is available in your browser. Bookmarks and notes are saved in the browser, and to your account once you sign in. On iPhone, text and illustrations are available offline. No account is needed, and personal notes stay on your device.
faq5A: Plus unlocks all {topics} breakdowns, {ideas} ideas, unlimited exports, and new editions. Buy it in the iPhone app as an auto-renewing annual subscription or lifetime access with a one-time payment. The current price is shown before purchase. Both options are paid upfront, with no free trial.
faq6Q: Can I use the material with AI?
faq6A: Yes. Export combines the full topic breakdown, your chosen idea, and your note into one text file (.txt). You can edit it, share it with your team, or give it to AI along with your question.
finalBody: Find a problem you'll want to solve.
